name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I spent more than two years at Accelo selling and implementing practice-management software to agencies and professional-services firms, so I know the customers ProfitSolv serves. A firm owner calling support is usually between client work and needs the fix explained once, in plain terms, without a lecture on how the software works underneath.

Most of my career has been the hands-on side of SaaS. At Accelo I guided clients through onboarding, workflow setup, and API integrations, troubleshooting alongside the implementation team and escalating the hard cases early. At Wix I walked 25+ small-business clients a month through setup and launch. At Birdeye I worked partners through complex technical configuration, built automated training sequences so the same questions stopped coming back, and sent prioritized customer feedback to Product and Engineering. I document every interaction, and I notice when the same issue shows up for the third time.
I'd welcome a conversation about the support team. I'm available at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
